recommendation: Conduct home visits and provide cultural support for heart failure patients
implementation_steps: Provide culturally and linguistically appropriate peer support
Conduct home visits to assess living conditions and medication adherence
Address social determinants of health by assisting with insurance, transportation, and employment resources
Foster trust through shared community background
Support self-management and medication adherence through coaching
evidence_summary: CHW-led home visits and cultural support interventions have been shown to improve medication adherence, self-care behaviors, and reduce hospital readmissions in heart failure patients from underserved communities.
citation: Implementation Science to Achieve Equity in Heart Failure Care
